task_completion.description: Open the M. genitalium genome file in UGENE
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE window shows 'm_genitalium_genome.gb' loaded in the Project View or as an active tab in the Sequence View.

task_completion.description: Filter annotations to show only CDS features
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Annotations Editor or Object View shows a filter applied for 'CDS', or only CDS features are highlighted/selected in the list.

task_completion.description: Open the 'Export sequence of annotations' dialog
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box titled 'Export sequence of annotations' or similar is visible over the main UGENE interface.

task_completion.description: Configure export settings to translate sequences using the correct genetic code
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the export dialog, the 'Translate to amino acids' option is checked. The translation table should be set to '4' or 'Mold, Protozoan, and Coelenterate Mitochondrial; Mycoplasma/Spiroplasma'.

task_completion.description: Save the translated sequences to the specified FASTA file path
task_completion.visual_evidence: The export dialog shows the output path set to '~/UGENE_Data/results/m_genitalium_proteome.fasta' and the process is initiated/completed.

task_completion.description: Create a text summary report with specific details
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or UGENE's internal editor) shows a file named 'extraction_report.txt' containing the organism name, a count of ~476 sequences, and mention of Translation Table 4.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the UGENE GUI rather than just terminal commands to generate files
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movement, menu interactions (Export > Export sequence of annotations), and UGENE dialog boxes rather than just a terminal window.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent didn't manually type the FASTA content
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the UGENE progress bar or the 'Export' button being clicked, indicating the software is generating the file.

integrity.description: Verify the agent interacted with the specific local directory structure
integrity.visual_evidence: The file browser or path input field in UGENE shows the directory '/home/user/UGENE_Data/results/'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: M. genitalium (NC_000908.2) has exactly 476-485 CDS features depending on the specific GenBank version; 476 is the standard expected count for this task. Translation Table 4 is critical because UGA encodes Tryptophan (W) instead of a Stop (*). If Table 1 (Standard) is used, the proteins will be prematurely truncated. The VLM should confirm the 'Translate' checkbox is active in the UGENE export dialog.
